answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 4825 Country: India Title: I am am insurance adviser. I do get commision from customer?s preimium. Which can be renewable or not. At the time of maturity of insurance the company is giving sum assured. So, i want to know the commision is halal or haram? Question: I am am insurance adviser. I do get commision from customer?s preimium. Which can be renewable or not. At the time of maturity of insurance the company is giving sum assured. So, i want to know the commision is halal or haram? Answer ID: 4825 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 939/875=D/1429) Life insurance is based on interest and gambling, therefore it is haram. It is unlawful to take commission on it; the income shall not be lawful. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
